audit: PLAYER ATTRIBUTES & POSSESSION ECONOMY AUDIT v1
scope: Static code truth for the canonical career V2 adapter and runtime. An attribute is not classified as effective merely because its name appears in a schema or a profile. Legacy routes are identified separately.

method.confidenceMeaning: HIGH means directly verified mapping/consumer code; MEDIUM means a sensitivity implication inferred from the verified formula. Consumer presence does not establish population effect size.

input.attributeValues: Retained production gameplay rating branches, including generated-prior provenance. No use of CA/PA.

quantitativeEvidence.executionBoundary: Shot cells run canonical released-shot perception, keeper flight reading, commitment, body movement, flight, contact and resolution until that shot ends. Other active bodies can respond through canonical AI. Passing signal cells report executePass scatter. Catch/interception cells isolate release and ball/catch resolution with stationary staged bodies, rather than making claims about collective moving-receiver AI.
quantitativeEvidence.supersededDevelopment: The earlier development-only direct-move/advanceBall shot harness omitted canonical released-shot keeper re-aiming. Its flat keeper outcomes cannot establish weak keeper attributes and are superseded by these canonical-tick cells.
quantitativeEvidence.note: Per-key observed p10/p50/p90 values, paired seeds, fixed unrelated ratings and equal physical capacities for technical-group trials. Shot outcomes run full canonical ticks; passing signals and staged catch/interception encounters have their distinct documented boundaries. These are implementation observations, not empirically calibrated league or athlete probabilities.

normalization.m: m(A,B,...) is the arithmetic mean of normalized attributes; repeated keys count repeatedly
normalization.missing: Absent/nonfinite values use raw10, normalized9/19; missing source provenance is retained

bridge.effect: Copies rating.branch.attributes[*].value into an AttributeSheet, then buildProfile at line94. No runtime CA/PA quality multiplier.

classificationLegend.DIRECT: Affects action execution, physical movement/cost, reaction, or actual interaction thresholds
classificationLegend.INDIRECT: Affects action appeal, perception/chance assessment, target choice, or tactical commitment rather than a distinct execution term
classificationLegend.PARTIAL: Has a real consumer but covers only part of the named action domain
classificationLegend.GATED: Mapped but consumed only behind a gate that normal ratings can saturate
classificationLegend.DEAD: Mapped into a profile field with no canonical runtime consumer
classificationLegend.UNMAPPED: Not read by canonical V2 buildProfile; changing only this branch attribute cannot independently change the resulting profile

limits: The superseded direct-move shot harness is excluded. Its flat keeper cells cannot establish attribute weakness.
64 trials applies to shot and passing-signal cells; catch and duel cells use128, interception cells384, physical/decision/containment rows are one deterministic task per tier.
Passing scatter is an actual release signal, not a measured pass-completion probability. Staged catch cells exercise moving ball resolution with fixed catch bodies, not collective moving-receiver AI.

centreRisk is one deterministic probe at the centre, not the average probability over actual scattered collision points. Actual delivery pace, landing point, pressure/alignment and fatigue change the risk reached by each trial.

Higher coherent technical-profile catch performance is not guaranteed: both passer and receiver change, pace changes and sampled failures can reverse despite better release accuracy. Report the reversal; do not tune a catch target.
Wing technique improves intended precision/spread while observed goals reverse in this geometry. Finite coupled trajectory and keeper outcomes do not establish a universal inverse skill relationship.

Keeper subtype flat cells can be reach/pace/context gated. No caught saves occurred in the27isolated keeper-variation cells;11held-save terminal outcomes occur in the other shot groups. Catch-only subskills are not broadly judged from conversion.

Physical work history exercises constant-speed locomotor/turning channels; acceleration/deceleration/contact/jump totals are0. Unchanged strength/balance/jump work rows do not show dead impulse costs.
The short movement task is partly acceleration-limited; equal TOP_SPEED arrival does not show topSpeed is dead. Its relative acute-work signal changes.

Same chosen decision in one geometry does not prove poor decisions. Capability/risk and read timing do change; broad cognition, off-ball, screen and pivot outcome differentiation remain incomplete or unmeasured.
Real roster identities are descriptive examples, not isolated single-attribute causal comparisons or verified athlete ability. Profiles include generated priors and derived values.
No physiology, league conversion, injury effect or automatic match-win calibration is established by these developer encounters.

scale.STRONG: Specific action effect clearly observed in the sampled paired task; no claim of league effect size
scale.ADEQUATE: Meaningful execution signals or scoped outcomes present, with contextual gaps
scale.WEAK: Narrow/gated coverage or limited/mixed outcome differentiation; does not automatically mean incorrect behavior
scale.UNKNOWN: Current encounter design does not establish the requested action-family outcome distinction

dispositions.GOOD_ENOUGH: Keep this scoped behavior; no runtime correction justified by this audit

differentiationScorecard.decisionScope: These are qualitative engineering judgments, not thresholds, physiology validation or proof that all skills must monotonically improve every seeded outcome. A family grade can contain strong subskills and UNKNOWN unexercised paths. Prioritization also needs the separate possession-economy evidence.
